title: 9x6 Willow Greenhouse
current_description: Clean lines and a single sloped roof keep the Willow compact enough to sit alongside a modern house without competing with it. The 9x6 frame is FSC-certified, kiln-dried cedar that resists rot, decay, and insects, and the glazing is 10mm 4-wall polycarbonate rated R-2.1, retaining 30% more heat than standard 6mm twin-wall while softening sunlight so there are no hot spots over the shelves. Inside, 54 square feet of floor space includes 13 linear feet of lower staging shelves and a slat wall for hanging baskets and tools, plus an interior water spigot. A thermostat-activated exhaust fan and a casement window handle ventilation. Pro-Tect testing rates it to 2,800 pounds of snow load and 100 mph winds, and it comes with a 5-year warranty.
current_excerpt: A compact 9x6 cedar greenhouse with a contemporary sloped roof, 54 sq ft of interior space, a slat wall, and R-2.1 4-wall polycarbonate glazing.
source_facts:
Clean lines and a contemporary sloped roof give the Willow 9x6 cedar greenhouse a compact, minimalist look that fits naturally alongside modern homes. We use 10mm 4-wall polycarbonate panels with an R-2.1 insulation value that retain 30% more heat than standard 6mm twin-wall, softening sunlight so you don't have to worry about hot spots. The FSC-certified, kiln-dried cedar frame naturally resists rot, decay, and insects, maintaining strength through seasonal exposure. Designed with a 54 square feet interior, 13 linear feet of lower staging shelves, and a slat wall, the Willow gives you a dedicated workspace for seedlings, pots, and hanging baskets. 

• FSC-certified, kiln-dried cedar frame that naturally resists rot, decay, and insects 

• 10mm 4-wall polycarbonate with R-2.1 insulation retains 30% more heat than standard 6mm twin-wall 

• 1 thermostat-activated exhaust fan plus 1 casement window for active and passive airflow 

• 54 sq ft interior with 13 linear feet of lower staging shelves 

• Interior water spigot included for watering inside the greenhouse 

• Pro-Tect™ tested to withstand 2,800 lbs of snow load and 100 mph winds 

• Comprehensive 5-year warranty with U.S.-based 7-day support and 48-hour parts shipping

title: Henley Outdoor Cabin Sauna – 2-4 Person
current_description:

The build is tongue-and-groove cedar with an 8mm tempered glass door and a powder-coated galvanized steel roof, put together to hold heat through every season. The PrairieFire 9kW electric heater reaches full temperature about 50% faster than a standard 6kW model.
Accessories come standard, so there is nothing else to buy: stones, a Wi-Fi control panel, a bucket and ladle, LED lighting and hooks. It arrives ready to assemble with step-by-step guidance in the BILT app, and a 5-year comprehensive warranty covers every component.

title: Knox Indoor Infrared Sauna – 2 Person
current_description:
Eight low-EMF far infrared carbon panels line this two-person cabin and reach your ideal temperature 20% faster, delivering full-body coverage whether you stretch out alone or sit side by side on the bench. It runs on a standard 120V outlet, so no electrician has to visit before the first session.
The cedar panels are 33% thicker with double-wall construction, and the tinted 8mm tempered glass door holds heat in while giving you real privacy in a shared room or an open floor plan. Red light therapy, chromotherapy, Bluetooth speakers, and the control panel are all standard rather than upgrades.
Panels arrive pre-built, pre-drilled, pre-stained, and pre-wired for assembly. A 5-year comprehensive warranty covers every component, with support available seven days a week.
